## Purpose and Entry Points
RAG-Anything is a Python 3.10 multimodal document RAG library built on LightRAG. It ingests documents or pre-parsed content, derives text and modality-specific semantic representations, indexes them through LightRAG, and answers text or VLM-enhanced queries. Primary public API: `RAGAnything` and configuration exports in `raganything/__init__.py`; orchestration resides in `raganything/raganything.py`.

## Core Orchestration and LightRAG Boundary
`RAGAnything` owns pipeline coordination while delegating persistence, embeddings, graph construction, vector retrieval, and baseline query modes to an injected or internally constructed LightRAG instance. Callers supply LLM, embedding, and optional vision-model functions; this keeps provider choice outside the library. Configuration and shared domain abstractions are in `raganything/config.py`, `raganything/base.py`, and `raganything/raganything.py`.

## Ingestion and Parser Boundary
Document ingestion accepts PDFs, Office files, images, text, audio/video, folders, or direct `content_list` insertion. The parser layer normalizes parser-specific output into the flat content-list contract, preserving page/order, captions, footnotes, paths, and structure. MinerU, Docling, and PaddleOCR are selectable external parser backends; MinerU output includes v2-to-legacy normalization. Key paths: `raganything/parser.py`, `raganything/mineru_content.py`, `raganything/batch_parser.py`.

## Content Routing and Processing
The processor splits normalized content into text chunks and modality work, retaining source-document identity and hierarchy. Text flows to LightRAG insertion; image, table, equation, generic, audio, and video items route to dedicated processors that generate descriptions and entities/chunks for the same knowledge base. Main paths: `raganything/processor.py`, `raganything/modalprocessors.py`, `raganything/modalprocessors_audio.py`, `raganything/modalprocessors_video.py`.

## Multimodal Enrichment and Graph Indexing
Modality processors use caller-provided caption/VLM functions to interpret non-text assets, then create indexed chunks and graph entities/relationships through LightRAG. This is the critical integration boundary: RAG-Anything enriches content and preserves cross-modal/document relationships, while LightRAG owns the graph/vector backends. Prompts and language-specific prompt management are centralized in `raganything/prompt.py`, `raganything/prompt_manager.py`, and `raganything/prompts_zh.py`.

## Query Paths
`aquery`/`query` forward text retrieval modes—hybrid, local, global, naive—to LightRAG. When enabled, query logic identifies retrieved image context, loads/encodes assets, and sends text plus images to the vision model. `aquery_with_multimodal` accepts caller-provided tables, equations, or other modal context alongside retrieval. Query assembly is in `raganything/query.py`; public coordination remains in `raganything/raganything.py`.

## Batch, Reliability, and Runtime Dependencies
Batch operations parallelize folder ingestion with dry-run/incremental behavior: `raganything/batch.py` and `raganything/batch_parser.py`. Resilience and callbacks provide operational hooks around asynchronous work: `raganything/resilience.py`, `raganything/callbacks.py`. Runtime infrastructure is Python asyncio plus LightRAG storage backends (file-based by default, externally configurable alternatives such as Neo4j). External services/tools include LLM/embedding/VLM APIs (OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, MiniMax examples), MinerU/Docling/PaddleOCR, LibreOffice for Office conversion, faster-whisper for audio, SceneDetect and ffmpeg for video, and optional CDN/object-storage URL mapping via `raganything/asset_urls.py`.
